title: Keto Norwegian Casserole
description: A delicious and creamy keto casserole made with Norwegian cheese and oozy cheesy goodness.
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the shredded Norwegian cheese and oozy cheese to the skillet. Stir until melted and smooth.
Transfer the cheese mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg, heavy cream, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the cheese mixture in the baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the casserole is set and the top is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
